name: Old Smoky, the Firedamp
place: dungeon mine_descent SET B: floor 1's mini-boss (a 24 m gallery)
_doc: Stream E (M2). The mine's bad air, grown a mind. Three gas pockets hiss in the walls: IGNITE one (use it) and it blows — it scorches Old Smoky and stuns it, but the flash comes back at you as a circle: light it and run. It drifts choking clouds that leave poison patches, and flares around itself. P2 at 50% 'Seepage': it splits off smaller wisps and starts dousing the lamps — darkness telegraphs (a ring you step into).
party: Solo: use the gas pockets for damage, run the flashback. 2-3: one ignites while the tank turns it away. 5: clouds overlap and crowd the gallery — spread. M5 scaling: cloud count 2 -> 1 solo / 3 at five; wisp adds by party.

onUse.say: WHUMP! The gas pocket goes up — Old Smoky gutters!
WHUMP! The gas pocket goes up — Old Smoky gutters!
WHUMP! The gas pocket goes up — Old Smoky gutters!

pull: The air goes thick and sweet. A miner's warning bell, rusted shut, tries to ring.
Something in the dark coughs. It is the dark.
say.death: Old Smoky thins to a sigh and is gone. The air smells of nothing at all.
say.reset: The air settles back into a lazy, poisonous haze.

enrage.say: The whole gallery fills with fire-damp!

flare.name: Firedamp Flare
flare.say: Old Smoky flares up — back off!

lamps_out.name: Lamps Out
lamps_out.say: The lamps die — step into the last ring of light!

split.name: Seepage
split.say: Old Smoky leaks smaller clouds of itself.

phases.name: Seepage
phases.say: The firedamp spreads through the whole gallery!
